title_en: An Open Space on the Map

commands.text: On returning to Oakhaven, Jori finds a supply cart waiting outside the gate. Its driver will not cross the charcoal yard.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: The captain is gone. Why is the road still empty?

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The captain was not the first reason it emptied.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: The yard has its own dead. We kept working around them until there was no way through.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: And you waited for the village to notice?

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I waited for someone else to sign the closure.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: I brought the old survey. One yard, ten places we have to account for.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: We open the road, keep the records, and leave the dead to people who can truly witness them.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: That is all I am asking. It is already more than anyone has promised us.
